name: מַהֲלַלְאֵל
summary: Mahalalel son of Kenan, of the line of Seth before the flood, who fathered Jared at sixty-five and lived 895 years, “and he died” (Gen 5:12–17; 1Ch 1:2); he is in the genealogy of Jesus (Luk 3:37, Μαλελεήλ). Also a man of Judah of the sons of Perez, ancestor of Athaiah who lived in Jerusalem after the return (Neh 11:4). The name is the noun מַהֲלָל “praise” (Pro 27:21) with אֵל: “praise of God”, or “God is praise”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Kenan lived seventy years and fathered מַהֲלַלְאֵל.”
“All the days of Mahalalel were 895 years, and he died.”
“Son of Jared, son of Μαλελεήλ, son of Cainan”; the Peshitta writes מַהלָלָאיֵל.
“Shephatiah son of מַהֲלַלְאֵל, of the sons of Perez.”
“A man according to his praise (מַהֲלָלוֹ)”: the noun that is the name's first part.

note: Takes e.bp.ai (7 tokens). m.ap.ac (מַהֲלָל, a zero-token cross-reference “מַהֲלַלְאֵל see הלל”) is given to the noun in halal.json. TIPNR records the antediluvian and the man of Neh 11:4 under separate keys; both are tagged. SEDRA lexeme 1718 MHLLA;L “Mahalaleel” is the Peshitta's spelling.
